nodes.label: s6-overlay Installer
nodes.rationale: Extracts s6-overlay 3.2.1.0 noarch plus the arch-specific tarball into /rootfs so the Dockerfile can COPY --from a single staged tree. s6 provides the multi-process supervision Frigate's container needs (frigate, nginx, go2rtc).

nodes.label: /rootfs Staging Pattern for COPY --from
nodes.rationale: Builder stages install their artifacts into /rootfs rather than the real filesystem so the final Dockerfile stage can COPY --from a single tree without dragging in build toolchains. The Intel media driver script creates an empty /rootfs on non-x86_64 purely so that COPY --from never fails on architectures where the stage is a no-op.
